panels.title: Recent Legion logs
panels.description: Docker and current-boot journald logs collected by Vector into VictoriaLogs.

panels.title: How to use this log plane

options.content:
### Querying
Use the Service variable to narrow logs, or use Search text for a bounded text filter. For raw LogsQL, open Grafana **Explore** and select **VictoriaLogs**.

### Direct endpoint
The VMUI/API is bound to Legion's tailnet address only: `http://<tailscale-ip>:9428/select/vmui/`. It is protected by the local observability credential and is not the recommended day-to-day path.

### Retention
VictoriaLogs keeps 30 days, with a 20 GB storage ceiling and a 10 GB free-space guard. Vector keeps a 4 GB disk buffer and blocks instead of silently dropping when the buffer fills.
